name: Пиньята
alt: Радужная пиньята-ослик воинственно размахивает своей палкой, рассыпая конфеты.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated colors, simple chunky forms, strong readable silhouette, minimal scenery, one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: A rainbow tissue-paper donkey piñata as a fantasy monster, exactly four legs and two long ears, one short ribbon tail. Three-quarter view; it defiantly grips a small wooden stick sideways in its mouth, reversed birthday-party joke. Little wrapped sweets spill from a small seam in its belly, no wound or gore. Bright layered magenta turquoise and yellow paper fringe, comically angry paper eyebrows, simple isolated silhouette.
